svg.aria-label: Figure 5. Centered-shape identity and 103 original bat individual vertical probability distributions
svg.title: Figure 5. Identity tests and descriptive probability profiles for vertical space use
svg.desc: Panel A shows calibrated whole-profile tests, including the non-supporting Tadarida case. Panel B contains the unmodified underlying probability vectors for 103 original individuals across five comparative panels, with ten height bins; the profiles are descriptive only.
svg.text: Inferential whole-profile results (A) and descriptive individual profiles (B)
A Identity persists after session-median centering
Calibrated excess (observed − permutation-null mean), nats per fix
Five comparative panels PASS; focal Tadarida FAIL (p = 0.5121)
Original leave-one-session-out, common-cell standardized profiles (103 individuals)
B: no component-wise significance test; color scale shared by all individual profiles.
